items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: Yeah, I booked Earl King from any time.

ctx.x: You booked, you booked Earl King, didn't you?
Yeah, I booked Earl King from any time. Okay, you told me. When you had my mother-in-law out, two or three more numbers, I got up. Yeah. The mother-in-law are very good friends.
You told me, you had a couple of years to do dough up in Brooklyn, and you also booked Joe Turner, I see you.
